_how_to_use: Rename this file to seeds.json (or copy entries into it). Each coin gets a list of configs to test. You only need to write the inputs you care about — everything missing is filled from that coin's current best config. Values are snapped to the nearest allowed value from params.json. Tested configs are never re-tested, so it is safe to leave entries in the file.

DEXEUSDT.note: example manual config — my hand-tuned setup
